LESSON: COMMUNAL ASPECTS OF YOGA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: General
Strand: Yoga
Topic 6.2: Communal aspects of Yoga

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Communal aspects of Yoga. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Communal aspects of Yoga
2. Practise Communal aspects of Yoga at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Communal aspects of Yoga

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Communal aspects of Yoga
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Communal aspects of Yoga. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Communal aspects of Yoga at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Communal aspects of Yoga at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Communal aspects of Yoga
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Communal aspects of Yoga. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Communal aspects of Yoga using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Communal aspects of Yoga in the examples.
2. Explain Communal aspects of Yoga to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Communal aspects of Yoga.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Communal aspects of Yoga using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Communal aspects of Yoga important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Communal aspects of Yoga
2. Practise Communal aspects of Yoga at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Communal aspects of Yoga

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
